text: Which of these is the categorical semantics of the Σ type Σ(x:A).B(x)?
choices: a coproduct in the fibre over A
the total space of the display map for B (the dependent sum is a left adjoint to weakening)
explanation: Σ types are the total space of B → A: Σ(x:A).B(x) is the domain of the display map. The Σ functor is left adjoint to weakening (context extension).
